title: Launching and running an instance
claim: An instance starts from an AMI and an instance type, runs in one Availability Zone, and is billed while it runs.
alt: A sequence with four participants: a launch template, Amazon EC2, the instance, and the instance metadata service. The template names the AMI and the instance type, EC2 places the instance in a subnet in one zone, and the instance gets role credentials from the metadata service.

messages.label: AMI, type
messages.say: You launch from a launch template that names the AMI, the instance type and the network settings.

messages.label: Subnet, one AZ
messages.say: Amazon EC2 places the instance in a subnet, which sits in one Availability Zone.

messages.label: AMI: software
messages.say: The AMI provides the software that the instance boots from.

messages.label: Type: hardware
messages.say: The instance type determines the hardware that the instance gets.

messages.label: Role credentials
messages.say: Code on the instance gets temporary credentials of its role from the instance metadata service.

messages.label: Running: billed
messages.say: Billing runs for the seconds the instance is in the running state.
